title: Scalar compatibility of normalized diagonal diagrams
statement: For diagrams of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category], a coefficient map and prescribed underlying line maps, define scalar compatibility using endpoints of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-endpoints] for all coefficient units, the two positive lines and the supported source. The unit maps are the actual coefficient maps and the supported map is their specified pushed diagonal map. For $q,p_1,p_2$, give restriction/direct-image isomorphisms normalized on every complex by the full right-derived universal units as in [det-prop-diagonal-tower-trace]. Their mates under the actual derived scalar adjunctions are the canonical scalar/direct-image maps. Require these mates invertible on the indicated shifted positive lines. Require the scalar extension of the diagonal arrow to equal the primed arrow through the prescribed endpoint isomorphisms, and require each of the three scalar trace squares to commute with those mates and endpoints. Both diagrams already contain their two integration equalities.
